title: C64 LLM-Wiki Page Frontmatter Schema
description: JSON Schema validating frontmatter metadata for compiled wiki pages under data/wiki/

id.description: Unique, lower-kebab-case slug identifier for the wiki page used in Obsidian wiki-links [[slug]]

type.description: The structural classification type of the wiki page

title.description: Human-readable display title for the page

aliases.description: Alternative names, symbols, or hexadecimal addresses for cross-referencing

tags.description: Categorical tags associated with the domain topic

path.description: Relative path to Layer 1 raw document (e.g., data/docs/c64ref/io-map/vic-ii/d020.md)

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the Layer 1 source document at time of ingestion

sources.description: Traceability array tracking source provenance back to Layer 1

created_at.description: Creation date of the page in YYYY-MM-DD format

updated_at.description: Last update date of the page in YYYY-MM-DD format

description.description: Detailed technical note describing the discrepancy between sources

contradictions.description: List of flagged technical contradictions between source materials

links_out.description: List of outbound wiki-link IDs referenced by this page
